name: ingenidev France Zones et Departements pour WC
author: ingenidev by Bright Vortex LLC

sections.description:
NEW Plugin! This WooCommerce plugin by ingenidev allows you to select each French department as a configurable shipping zone with its own options.

WordPress and WooCommerce already have a feature called “shipping zones” that helps online stores manage their shipping logistics. However, this feature is not configured for France’s specific delivery requirements, where deliveries are organized by department rather than default zones. The France Zones and Departments for WooCommerce plugin specifically adds departments to the system, allowing store owners to easily configure delivery rules within the French context. It integrates seamlessly with the existing system, providing precise control over shipping costs and delivery times for each department.

Simplify Shipping in France with the France Zones and Departments for WooCommerce Plugin

Simplify your WooCommerce checkout process for French customers with the France Zones and Departments for WooCommerce plugin. This plugin replaces standard international address fields with a user-friendly department and region selection, ensuring accurate and efficient delivery throughout France.

WordPress and WooCommerce already have a feature called “shipping zones” that helps online stores manage their shipping logistics. However, this feature is not configured for France’s specific delivery requirements, where deliveries are organized by department and region rather than default zones. The France Zones and Departments plugin adds departments and regions to the system, allowing store owners to easily configure delivery rules within the French context.

Why Optimize French Addresses in WooCommerce?

Using standard international address fields can lead to confusion and errors for French customers. By implementing department-specific fields, you can:

✓ Improve Checkout Experience: Provide more intuitive and localized address input.
✓ Reduce Delivery Errors: Ensure accurate address data for faster and more reliable deliveries.
✓ Enhance Customer Satisfaction: Offer a seamless checkout process tailored to French users.
✓ Optimize Delivery Logistics: Simplify address management for France-specific delivery.

France Zones and Departments for WooCommerce Plugin Features

✅ Replaces Standard Address Fields: Replaces default address fields with a department dropdown.
✅ Easy Department Selection: Allows customers to select their department from a comprehensive list (96 departments including overseas territories).
✅ Seamless WooCommerce Integration and Shipping Zone Configuration.
✅ Works flawlessly with all WooCommerce themes and plugins.
✅ Simple and Easy Configuration: No complex settings or coding required.
✅ Lightweight and Optimized: Designed for minimal impact on your store’s performance.
✅ Full French Translation: Interface fully available in French.

How to Use This Plugin?

  1. Install and activate the France Zones and Departments for WooCommerce plugin.
  2. The plugin automatically replaces standard address fields with department selection.
  3. No additional configuration is usually necessary unless you need specific rules per department – it’s ready to use!
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping to configure your shipping zones by department if needed.

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • WooCommerce store owners who ship products to France and overseas territories.
  • Businesses looking to improve the checkout experience for French customers.
  • E-commerce stores aiming to reduce delivery errors and improve delivery efficiency and accuracy.
  • Shops that want to provide localized and user-friendly address input.

Included Departments

The plugin includes all 96 French departments:

  • 95 metropolitan France departments (01-95)
  • 2 Corsica collectivities (2A-Corse-du-Sud, 2B-Haute-Corse)
  • 5 overseas departments (971-Guadeloupe, 972-Martinique, 973-Guyane, 974-Réunion, 976-Mayotte)

Optimize Your Shipping in France Today!

Enhance your WooCommerce store’s shipping capabilities for French customers with the France Zones and Departments for WooCommerce plugin. Ensure accurate and efficient deliveries with localized address selection.

Privacy Notice

This plugin, by itself, does not:

  • track users;
  • write any user personal data to the database;
  • send any data to external servers;
  • use cookies.
